name: When should I consider using Google Ads for my luxury property listing?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider using Google Ads for my luxury property listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider using Google Ads for your luxury property listing when you want to achieve maximum exposure quickly, target specific high-net-worth buyers, or when your property is in a highly competitive market like Midtown/Wynwood or Brickell. It's particularly effective when your goal is to generate qualified leads proactively and reduce the time your property spends on the market. Google Ads provide an immediate strategic advantage for properties that demand a premium audience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider Google Ads for luxury listings when you need maximum, quick exposure to high-net-worth buyers, especially in competitive markets, to proactively generate leads.
